description: Use when an agent needs one check for what is abnormal across Hyperliquid perps right now. Returns funding, liquidation and open-interest anomalies in one ranked list, using the thresholds of /api/market-state, or nothing abnormal with what was checked. If a source is stale and nothing else was found it answers 503 rather than an all-clear, and is never billed. Costs 0.02 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).
